In the early years of the [[New Sith Wars]], this '''battle''' was held between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. One of the combatants was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Pernicar]], who during the heat of battle spotted his former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Wud Mortull]], fighting for the opposite side. Mortull, upon spotting Pernicar, charged the Jedi Master; however, Pernicar deftly cut Mortull down.
